headline: AI-driven deals lifted profit for many firms, but top‑line growth remained uneven.
summary: Coforge posted the strongest top‑line expansion with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Mid‑tier players such as LTM, Tech Mahindra and HCLTech delivered solid double‑digit growth, helped by AI‑led contracts. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and showed only modest profit growth, highlighting a slowdown among the largest integrators. Overall, AI revenue contributions were noted across the sector, but the impact on margins varied.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue growth
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, driving higher profits and larger deal wins.

themes.title: Margin guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin target, while Infosys cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
